Born on January 13, 1984, in Rosario, Argentina, Molinari has been a prominent figure in South American gymnastics and has represented Argentina in several international competitions.

Molinari’s gymnastics career is marked by his participation in the Olympic Games. He represented Argentina at the 2012 London Olympics and the 2016 Rio de Janeiro Olympics. While he did not claim any medals at these Games, his participation was significant for Argentine gymnastics, contributing to the sport's visibility and development in his home country.

In addition to his Olympic appearances, Federico Molinari has competed in several World Championships and other international competitions, such as the Pan American Games, where he has been more successful in terms of securing medals. His specialties mainly lie in events such as the rings and the horizontal bar, with the rings being his stronger event.

His career has also been influential in inspiring younger athletes in Argentina to take up gymnastics, contributing to the sport’s growth at a grassroots and professional level within the country.
